name: Box Score Scout external analytics tool (nflverse, RBSDM-comparable)
census_status: EXTERNAL-REFERENCE — free, no-account external tool; held as a methodology + spot-check reference, not an engine dependency
stamp_required: site features read 2026-10-15; underlying data nflverse through Week 5
stamp_gap: percentile conventions are published (10th/50th/90th of 2016-2025 regular seasons); site refresh cadence is not stamped per feature

record.source: boxscorescout.com, read directly 2026-10-15 (profile, pinned post, glossary description)
record.data_source_credit: nflverse / nflfastR play-by-play, EPA and win-probability models; EPA conventions as rbsdm.com applies them (author's glossary)
record.methodology_endpoint: site glossary (boxscorescout.com) — methodology of record for xFP, kicker and comp definitions
record.coverage: data back to 1999 (with noted gaps for stats recorded later)

features.name: player/team statistical comps
features.definition: similarity-scored comparable players/teams for every player and team (similarity % shown)

features.name: expected fantasy points (xFP)
features.definition: per the site glossary; opportunity-based expected fantasy scoring

features.name: advanced kicker stats
features.definition: xFG% (expected field-goal percentage) and FGOE (field goals over expected)

features.name: percentile tables
features.definition: player/team stats shown against 10th/50th/90th percentiles of 2016-2025 regular seasons

features.name: matchup matrix
features.definition: offensive success rate x defensive success rate allowed, FEAST / UGLY quadrant framing, weekly

features.name: custom charting tool + cumulative history charts
features.definition: self-serve chart builder; cumulative EPA/yards career-trajectory charts since 1999

record.stamped_instance: 2026-10-15 TNF QB card (2026 qualified-QB percentiles): Darnold EPA/play 13th pct (-0.08), CPOE 67th pct (+2.0%), Y/A 70th pct (7.7), TD% 97th pct (7.1%), INT% 0th pct (5.1%); Nix EPA/play 25th pct (-0.02), CPOE 15th pct (-2.4%), Y/A 7th pct (5.8), sack% 90th pct (3.2%); Week 6 matchup matrix placed DEN offense into SEA defense in the UGLY quadrant (medians 43.3% / 42.9%)
record.role: external-tool record: a free nflverse-family reference whose EPA conventions are directly comparable to RBSDM — usable for cross-checks of in-house numbers; the engine does not depend on it
